c.v: Most of the instructions in PIE allow loading or storing data from/to
Q registers in parallel in one cycle.
In most cases, the data should be
aligned, and the lower 4 bits of address will be ignored.
The Address unit provides functionality to manipulate address registers in parallel, which saves the time to update address registers.
It is possible to make address register operations like AR + signed constant, ARx + ARy, and AR + 16.
The Address unit makes post-processing operations.
It means that all operations with address registers are done after instructions are finished.
